subject: CeresBio — concierge bundle + custom integration (exec signoff requested)
messages:
From: Alex Greene <alex.greene@ceresbio.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Lopez <maya.lopez@ceresbio.com>, procurement@ceresbio.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Inquiry: concierge + integration scope for DB-2026-1749

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at CeresBio likes the performance profile and the idea of a single runtime across our environments. We have one ask before we can move to terms: our product team requires a small custom integration (on-prem connector for our internal ETL) and an onboarding concierge (week-of support during production launch).

Can Redwood include the concierge onboarding (3 days of dedicated support with two engineers) and the custom connector work in the first-year bundle? Our procurement team has budget for the hosted API and the Dedicated pool, but this custom work would push us over the approved spend unless there is a bundled credit/discount.

Attaching a short integration spec and our initial SOW asks. Looking for a rough price + whether this is something you can approve or needs exec review.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
CeresBio

Attachments: integration_spec_initial.docx, CeresBio_SOW_v1.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@ceresbio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inquiry: concierge + integration scope for DB-2026-1749

Alex — appreciated. Quick summary of what we can do without exec review: standard onboarding (1 day) + up to 8 hours of integration help at our published rates. Anything beyond that (dedicated concierge days or custom on-prem connector dev) requires deal desk approval because it impacts professional services credits and >20% of ARR in one-off work.

High level estimate (ballpark):
- Concierge onboarding (3 days, 2 engineers): $18k
- Custom on-prem connector (fixed scope as in your spec): $45k
- Hosted / Dedicated annual consumption (estimated): $240k

To keep this moving, I put together a bundle option: waive 50% of concierge fee ($9k credit) and offer a one-time $25k services credit toward the connector if we get exec signoff for a bundled commitment (12 months Dedicated + Hosted). That would bring first-year out-of-pocket professional services to ~$20k.

I need an executive sign-off for the $25k services credit and the 10% commercial concession on first-year list price (this is a non-standard concession). Marissa, Neha — looping you for deal desk signoff and any suggested guardrails (SLA, delivery timeline). Ben — finance, please flag margin/approval path.

If it's helpful, I can propose conditional language for the SOW (credit applied after sign-off and acceptance of integration deliverables).

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_summary_ceresbio.xlsx
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: CeresBio — concierge bundle + custom integration (exec signoff requested)

All — reviewed. Quick notes:
- $25k services credit and a 10% commercial concession on year-1 price are both material but reasonable for a strategic bioscience account.
- Condition approvals on: signed SOW with defined deliverables + milestone-based credit release (50% after initial delivery, 50% after acceptance testing).
- Add a clause preventing credits from being applied to future renewal revenue (credits only for year-1 professional services).
- Require a delivery SLA for the connector: 8-week delivery target from SOW signature, with a change-order process for scope creep.

I’m comfortable granting exec-level approval for the following (subject to legal/finance tickboxes):
1) One-time $25k services credit tied to connector deliverable milestones.
2) Up to 3 concierge days included (value $9k) as in Karthik's suggested bundle.
3) 10% concession on year-1 list price for total committed consumption if CeresBio signs the 12-month bundle by Jan 31.

Neha — please confirm the finance guardrails (margin floor/approval). Ben — please confirm how we want to reflect the credit in the invoice (line-item credit vs separate credit memo). Lauren — loop legal to draft the limited SOW addendum and milestone language.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: CeresBio — concierge bundle + custom integration (exec signoff requested)

Marissa — finance checked. Summary:
- $25k services credit approved if deal gross margin remains >= 42% post-credit. Current modeled gross margin at proposed concession is 45%, so we have a ~3-point buffer.
- Credit needs to be applied as a contra revenue line on the initial invoice; finance prefers a separate credit memo only for internal tracking if requested by accounting.
- Require a one-time approval entry in the deal desk queue and a FYI to Revenue Ops for recognition treatment.

Ben — if you agree with credit memo approach, we can proceed to legal. Also propose we track connector deliverable acceptance in the Redwood Console ticket for audit.

-Neha
Head of Revenue Finance
